answer_1.quote: We evaluated our model on two public customer review datasets SPACE hotel reviews and AMAZON product reviews ... Opinion summarization is the task of automatically generating digests for an entity ...
answer_1.outputs: extractive summaries consisting of selected review sentences

answer_2.quote: We report ROUGE F-scores that compares the overlap between generated text with gold summaries ... We also compute perplexity (PPL) score to evaluate the readability of summaries ... we compute the percentage of distinct n-grams (n = 2) ... we measure aspect coverage of a system, by computing the average number of distinct aspects N_ASP in the generated summaries.

answer_4.quote: We performed human evaluations for the general and aspect summaries. Summaries were judged by 3 human annotators on three criteria: informativeness, coherence and non-redundancy ... For aspect summaries ... judged based on two criteria: aspect informativeness and aspect specificity.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were presented summaries in a pairwise manner and asked to select which one was better/worse/similar based on the specified criteria.
